page.overview:
What is Oxenfurt Harbor?

Oxenfurt Harbor is the dock area of Oxenfurt.

In the s, Myhrman ran an illegal store in the docks, selling medical items to people such as Shani and Rience. It ended in , when Philippa Eilhart tortured him for information.

In , King Radovid's galley docked there, heavily guarded by his men. Two other ships were also moored at its gangplanks.
